answer: Draw a jury, hash the work, compare two scores. Any score past tolerance slashes the outlier, and a panel drawn entirely from one subnet voids the vote and redraws. The figure that decides the design is one: a forged key must cost more than an honest epoch, so the stake sits above that. A thousand keys means a thousand stakes held at once, with no haven in a shared rack, and no sonnet about decentralization pays them back. The bill hits its zenith before one answer is graded.
